sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, o.created_at::text AS t, 'alimm' AS b, o.market_ticker AS c, coalesce(o.side,'-') AS d, o.limit_price::text AS e, coalesce(o.status,'-') AS f FROM live_orders o WHERE o.strategy='Alimm1' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 3) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, max(p.captured_at)::text, 'pos', p.market_ticker, coalesce(p.side,'-'), p.quantity::text, coalesce(p.realized_pnl::text,'-') FROM positions p WHERE p.captured_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' AND (p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26%' OR p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXRT-RES%') GROUP BY p.market_ticker, p.side, p.quantity, p.realized_pnl) UNION ALL (SELECT 3 AS g, at::text, 'ledger', balance_cents::text, coalesce(residual_cents::text,'-'), coalesce(buy_cost_cents::text,'-'), coalesce(notes_json::text,'-') FROM incentive_balance_observations ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 4)) u ORDER BY g, t DESC
